title: Emergent BioSolutions to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: GAITHERSBURG, Md., May 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Emergent BioSolutions Inc. (NYSE: EBS) announced today that members of the company’s senior management team will participate in the following investor conferences: Goldman Sachs 11th Annual Leveraged Finance and Credit Conference, May 27-29
